swag-labs.name: Swag Labs (saucedemo.com demo shop)
swag-labs.notes: UI only. Public demo credentials are shown on its login page.

shady-meadows.name: Shady Meadows B&B (Restful Booker Platform demo)
shady-meadows.notes: UI + JSON API. Shared public sandbox: data is reset periodically and other people write to it.

restful-booker.name: Restful Booker (booking API demo)
restful-booker.notes: API only. Shared public sandbox, data resets periodically.

the-internet.name: The Internet (UI test playground)
the-internet.notes: UI only. Some pages load slow third-party assets: the load event can hang.

conduit.name: Conduit (RealWorld demo, Angular + JSON API)
conduit.notes: UI (Angular SPA) + JSON API with JWT (Authorization: Token <jwt>). Shared sandbox: list/comment visibility is scoped per user. Users cannot be deleted via the API.

contact-list.name: Contact List App (thinking-tester, UI + REST API)

juice-shop.name: OWASP Juice Shop (public demo)
juice-shop.notes: Angular SPA (hash routes) + REST API on the same origin; JWT Bearer. Shared demo, may be reset at any time.

automation-exercise.name: Automation Exercise (demo shop + practice API)
automation-exercise.notes: UI + form-encoded API under /api. Third-party ads and consent overlays on the UI.
